what: A strip of horizontally lined cells that wraps endlessly — the wheel (larger of vertical·horizontal × 2) and drag push the target position, and the visible position follows by 6% per 60fps frame (corrected by frame time). On release it glides further by velocity × .3. The movement speed (px per frame, up to 100) is multiplied by −.002, so cells shrink from 1 → .8x, and when it stops they return to 1x at the same 6%. Cells wrap by strip width, so a cell leaving on the left rejoins at the right end.

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells to wrap (several, required) — lined up side by side with flex in the row, gap between is the strip’s column-gap
options.[data-fx-part=squish]: Panel that shrinks and expands inside the cell (the cell itself if none)
options.wheel: Wheel multiplier, default 2 — at 0 the wheel is ignored (the page scrolls down)
options.squish: Share that shrinks per 1px of speed, default .002 (0 means no shrinking)
options.fx:move: Event an element fires when its position changes (detail.x)
